title: Assembly provenance
description: Declares which registered assembly this agreement instantiates — the composition's identity, committed under agreementHash and attestable as on-chain evidence. The designer composes this clause into the assembly; the field fills mechanically at checkout with the template's own compositionHash (it cannot be a designer value: the hash cannot appear inside the composition it hashes). A buyer attestation of this section is the on-chain event that links a process to its assembly — the linkage the RPGF distribution credits assembly designers of record from. The provenance article is scoring infrastructure and is itself excluded from RPGF scoring.

fields.name: compositionHash
fields.description: The AssemblyRegistry compositionHash of the assembly this agreement was instantiated from (bytes32 hex).
